name: Ganeko Mayu
source:
A promising player from the Shitou Suisan Academy. Like Arika, she is an onee-sama that swings "that" way. Arika's senpai. She's on what you might consider "good terms" with Arika, and is always being called onee-sama by her. She loves small and cute things.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
来自紫藤水产学院的有前途选手。和有里香一样，她是喜欢“往那边”挥拍的大姐姐，也是有里香的前辈。她与有里香关系“不错”，对方总称呼她为大姐姐。她喜欢小巧可爱的东西。

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
